The five files carry no comments beyond the package doc
fix: Hash a comment-stripped code shape (commentaudit's shape) so the pin tracks the algorithm only; strip the five files; delete the comment-reading test; make the nil-run test assert; fix the doc.

summary: TestDecisionVersion_PinnedToAlgorithmSurface hashes the raw bytes of classifier.go, latest.go, complete.go, lineage.go and newestwins.go, so any comment edit forces a pin change and round 12 deferred them (stripped copies and the new pin are in the round-12 scratchpad). title: modelquery's decision-surface pin hashes raw bytes, comments included, so five files cannot shed their comments
